notes: Primary source: official Crestron spec sheet PDF (ss_DM-NVX-350, Rev 09/20/22), Connectors section on page 6, cross-checked against docs.crestron.com specifications and installation pages. This is a compact desktop/surface-mount unit (8.61 x 9.27 x 1.50 in), not rack-mountable as a standalone RU (can optionally attach to a single rack rail via accessory), so rackUnits omitted. HDMI grade set to hdmi-2.0 as an inference: Crestron specifies an 18 Gbps TMDS bandwidth requirement for full 4K60 4:4:4/HDR10 performance, which corresponds to HDMI 2.0 signaling; the spec sheet does not explicitly state "HDMI 2.0" by version number. Ethernet grade eth-1g is explicit (1000BASE-T). USB ports are explicitly USB 2.0. The COM port and Console-Serial port are both RS-232 but on different physical connectors (COM = 5-pin terminal block, bidirectional device control; Console-Serial = RJ-45, setup-only console) - modeled as separate ports. Device can be field-configured as either an encoder (Tx) or decoder (Rx); the physical ports are identical either way. A chassis ground lug (6-32 screw, labeled "G") exists but was omitted as it is not a signal/power connector in the requested taxonomy.

ports.name: Console, USB
